evals.prompt: Review this workflow job: lint has uses: example/catalog/.github/workflows/lint.yml@main and also steps: [{run: 'echo extra'}]. I need reusable lint plus my own steps.
evals.expected_output: Identify incompatible job-level uses/steps with location evidence; propose a step action or separate jobs without requiring Docker universally.

evals.prompt: In tdesaules/github-actions, replace our linter action with a host Python composite and build its image with FROM golang as build and FROM scratch as runtime. Review this proposal against my existing conventions without changing them.
evals.expected_output: Distinguish valid GitHub composite syntax from a violation of the user's dedicated Docker/fixed-operation Go contract. Preserve direct uses calls; accept scratch only with a complete suitable runtime closure. Flag the unlisted golang builder and propose an allowed builder. Retain the documented infrastructure and Buildah exceptions.

evals.prompt: build needs check and lint. check succeeds with has_images=true but lint is skipped when no lint files changed. build is unexpectedly skipped. Fix routing while still rejecting lint failures and cancellation.
evals.expected_output: Address needs/status semantics with explicit result checks, test success/skipped/failure/cancellation, and avoid always-only publication conditions.

evals.prompt: Review only this proposed tdesaules/github-actions CI: separate pr.yml/build.yml/release.yml files, pull_request enabled, a single combined build/test job, Trivy scans, v1.2.3 Git tags, and images published as ghcr.io/other/catalog:latest. Restore my repository conventions in your recommendation; no credentials are available.
evals.expected_output: Recommend one main.yml named main with check/lint/build/test/release/maintenance, branch/tag push plus main-only manual preparation and maintenance schedules, no PR trigger unless requested, dedicated multistage Docker actions using allowlisted bases with scratch preferred where suitable, containerized Grype with non-blocking findings/error reporting, Git tags without v, and ghcr.io/tdesaules/github-actions/<image> digest references without catalog SemVer/latest aliases. Do not publish or invent digests.

evals.prompt: Implement the six-job routing for three cases: no changed files, action.yml-only changes, and a valid release tag. The existing workflow uses has_images to gate both build and test and tolerates any skipped lint job. Explain exact flags, matrix sources, needs and release gating without publishing.
evals.expected_output: Load the job contract. Empty selection skips all phases after check. Metadata-only changes use published-image test entries with has_images=false and has_tests=true. Tags skip build, lint/test the full release set at published digests and use publish mode. Gate skipped dependencies only when their own selection flags are false; a skipped selected lint job blocks downstream work.

evals.prompt: Define the manual prepare flow when only catalog metadata changed and existing digests are reused, then the follow-up tag flow. Also handle no version bump and main advancing before tagging.
evals.expected_output: Require dispatch prepare on main; perform full applicable lint and release-set tests/scans without rebuilding unchanged images. Prepare verifies reused digests, updates references/notes, rechecks captured main, atomically pushes final commit/tag, and creates no GitHub Release. No bump is an explicit no-op. Tag mode verifies the complete published set and publishes only the GitHub Release. A source race fails without moving a tag or misattributing reused image source commits.

evals.prompt: Our schedule runs maintenance but maintenance needs check, which is skipped. Add manual maintenance too, keeping release isolated. Renovate lacks credentials, and scan/link checks are otherwise runnable.
evals.expected_output: Give maintenance no needs; route schedules and dispatch mode=maintenance to it alone, reject manual non-main refs explicitly, and retain the dedicated bot contract. Run independent scans/link checks and preserve reports even if Renovate fails; aggregate failure instead of reporting skipped Renovate as success. No builds, image promotion, release tags or GitHub Releases. Dependency PR creation is distinct from enabling pull_request workflow triggers.

evals.prompt: A candidate AMD64/ARM64 matrix has successful job results, but the ARM64 receipt is missing, AMD64 says tested:false, and test rebuilt the binary image. Can release promote these archives? Define the expected build/test artifact contract.
evals.expected_output: Reject promotion because functional qualification/artifact integrity is incomplete. Build receipts bind source/component/platform/run and archive checksums with tested:false. Test consumes the exact candidate archive, verifies integrity, exercises required runtime cases, attempts advisory Syft/Grype reporting and emits tested:true only after functional success. Require the complete functional evidence set; security reports are not a gate. Do not use matrix success or a reconstructed artifact as a substitute for evidence.

evals.prompt: Our exact candidate archives and runtime tests pass. Grype reports critical CVEs, another platform's DB refresh fails, and Syft produces no SBOM. Make security non-blocking without hiding results or disabling functional gates. Include scan-only maintenance behavior.
evals.expected_output: Use isolated step-level continue-on-error for security tools and their report uploads, bounded timeouts, and real step outcomes/tool diagnostics rather than coerced conclusions. Remove severity and final aggregate security failure gates, retain findings/error/not_run statuses and warnings, and permit functional qualification/release. Scanner-only maintenance failures remain advisory; failed functional tests or missing candidate receipts still block.

evals.prompt: Image publication and functional tests succeeded, but Cosign cannot obtain signing credentials and a reused image signature has the wrong issuer. The collection's security policy must not block CI. Should release continue? What if the registry upload itself fails?
evals.expected_output: Continue release despite signing/verification errors, report unsigned/unverified status accurately, and do not treat those errors as clean or impose a new approval gate. Keep image digests, base selection and secret-handling rules. A failed registry upload is a blocking publication error, not an optional security failure; never apply continue-on-error to the whole release job.

evals.prompt: Our dedicated Docker action runs a KAS/Yocto build and needs Python, Git, shell utilities and a complete Fedora toolchain at runtime. May its final stage use quay.io/fedora/fedora? A separate static linter only needs its executable and CA certificates. Review both choices without weakening the base allowlist.
evals.expected_output: Allow the Fedora final stage under the general needs-based runtime rule, without a KAS-specific exception or manually copying the distribution into scratch. Prefer scratch for the static linter when its complete dependencies are present. Keep multistage dedicated images, all-stage/donor allowlisting, resolved tags/digests and actual native qualification; do not extend approval to unlisted repositories.
